title: Tactile 0.40 零泄露架构升级与极致省电优化

notes.zh:
Tactile 0.40 重点更新：
• 全工程 UI 与状态管理全面迁移至 macOS 14+ 原生 @Observable / @Bindable，消除高频状态变更引起的视图树重建开销
• 零磁盘缓存与自动关闭网络客户端：彻底消除 Cache.db / httpstorages.sqlite 常驻文件句柄，授权与更新检查完成后自动断开 HTTPS 连接并严格冷却节流
• 深度内存泄露与增长治理：HUD/轨迹/置顶贴图/剪贴板弹窗关闭即卸载视图并回收缓冲；截图复制采用单通道直接 PNG 编码，峰值内存与主线程耗时大幅下降
• 剪贴板后台异步化与智能节流：大图缩略图及 JPEG 压缩移至后台线程，轮询随前后台动态降频并在系统休眠时自动暂停
• 120Hz 触控与全局事件链路降耗：修复 FPS 与防误触时钟基准错配，空闲帧与非追踪拖拽零 C 调用直通，移除重复全局键盘监听并消除后台 QoS 调度抖动
• 设置界面懒加载优化：长手势列表与运行应用选择器改用 LazyVStack、复用意图格式化器与成本受控图标缓存，并完成 Xcode 16/27 全链路零警告编译与 Apple 公证
notes.en:
Tactile 0.40 Highlights:
• Full codebase migration to modern macOS 14+ @Observable / @Bindable Observation framework, minimizing SwiftUI view rebuild overhead
• Zero-disk-cache auto-closing network client: eliminates persistent Cache.db / httpstorages.sqlite file handles, closes HTTPS sockets immediately after checks, and enforces launch/integrity cooldowns
• Deep memory leak & footprint fixes: tears down HUD, trail, pinned screenshot, and clipboard views on close; direct single-pass PNG encoding eliminates 30–50MB TIFF round-trip spikes
• Off-main-thread clipboard compression & adaptive polling: processes large images on utility workers and throttles/pauses polling in background and sleep
• 120Hz touch & EventTap CPU reduction: fixes FPS/click-suppression clock domain mismatch, removes duplicate global key monitors, and eliminates per-lift QoS churn
• LazyVStack & formatter reuse across Settings views, shipped as Apple-notarized Universal 2, Apple Silicon, and Intel builds
